description.value: Cathedral Lakes Lodge is one of Canada's highest full-service wilderness lodges, situated at 2000 metres elevation on Quiniscoe Lake in Cathedral Provincial Park. The lodge offers all-inclusive accommodations across lodge rooms, bungalows, and private cabins, with access to over 60 km of alpine hiking trails. It also provides transport services for backcountry campers, making it a rare full-service basecamp deep in the southern BC wilderness.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Cathedral Lakes Lodge is a real, operating wilderness lodge in Cathedral Provincial Park at 2000m elevation, open seasonally. The website lists two phone numbers (+1 888-255-4453 and 1-778-622-0372) that differ from the OSM number (+1-250-226-7560), flagged as a concern. No bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so all bike-related criteria are null.

enrichment_extras.notes: Lodge is open seasonally (example: June 12 to October 12, 2026 per website). Accessibility for cyclists with bikes is unclear given the remote alpine location and lodge-provided transport as the primary access method.
